title.narrative: Intersectoral response to reduce malnutrition in drought and conflict-affected people in Gablalu Woreda, Somali Region.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe primary objective of this project is to save lives, reduce mortality rates, and alleviate acute malnutrition and disease burdens by implementing integrated, dignity-focused intersectoral activities. These initiatives are meticulously designed to combine immediate life-saving actions with sustainable solutions, all within an ambitious eight-month timeframe.lt/pgtltpgtA critical need has been identified to address deficiencies in primary healthcare services, especially in areas hosting internally displaced persons (IDPs). Limited availability of medications, medical supplies, and trained health professionals, along with the absence of a robust disease surveillance system, has led to significant health vulnerabilities. To address these challenges, emergency health response activities are being planned, focusing on drought-affected communities in Gablalu Woreda, Somali regional state. The deployment of Mobile Health and Nutrition Teams is crucial to improving access to essential primary healthcare and referral services. These teams will offer a comprehensive range of services, including adult and pediatric consultations, reproductive healthcare, and mental health support.lt/pgtltpgtThroughout the project, a strong commitment will be maintained to uphold the dignity and rights of beneficiaries, while actively avoiding discrimination or harm. Data will be disaggregated by sex, age, and diversity to inform tailored programs that reach the most vulnerable individuals. Our staff will receive training on gender sensitivity and protection from sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA) to ensure a safe environment for survivors of gender-based violence (GBV) to access specialized services. Additionally, the project aims to enhance the participation of women, girls, and persons with disabilities in decision-making processes. Transparency and accountability will be ensured through robust feedback mechanisms.ltbrgtlt/pgt
